rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: A reasonably valued large pharma with strong 12-month momentum that sits near its highs. It is a defensive anchor while health care leads the market.
rows.risks: Worries about the Keytruda patent expiry or a disappointing pipeline update at third-quarter results.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: The leading US steelmaker, with a strong trend, about 4% below its high, helped by tariff-protected pricing and a solid balance sheet.
rows.risks: Steel prices could weaken if industrial demand slows.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: A fee-based midstream business with volume growth from the Permian basin. It is a steadier way to own energy and trades near its highs.
rows.risks: Lower Permian drilling activity or weaker natural gas liquids prices.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: A best-in-class refiner benefiting from wide refining margins, with heavy share buybacks and a strong trend (+50% over three months).
rows.risks: Refining margins could fall back from their high levels around third-quarter results.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: The leading endpoint-security platform. The long-term trend is intact after the October selloff, and annual recurring revenue keeps compounding.
rows.risks: A premium valuation leaves it exposed to any further sell-off in software.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: A profitable security company with a firewall upgrade cycle under way and strong momentum. It is cheaper than security-software peers.
rows.risks: Weaker firewall orders or a further fall in high-growth tech stocks.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: A large, efficient refiner with high free cash flow and returns to shareholders, riding the same strong margin cycle as Marathon.
rows.risks: Combined with Marathon, I am heavily exposed to refining margins.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: A simplified DuPont after its portfolio split, with good momentum and rising this week.
rows.risks: Execution and demand risk in the businesses that remain after the split.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Benefits from storage demand for AI data, with a reasonable valuation and steady buybacks. The one-month trend is strong.
rows.risks: If the hardware correction spreads to storage, the stock could fall.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: A cheap generics drugmaker turning around, near its 52-week high and in a strong defensive sector.
rows.risks: Generic price erosion and its debt load.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Its earnings are recovering and it has re-rated strongly, trading near its highs as life-science tools lead health care.
rows.risks: High volatility and the risk of a pullback after a +194% year.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Test and measurement equipment, helped by demand from AI, networking and defense, with strong 12-month momentum.
rows.risks: Cyclical orders could slow and the stock sits only 8% above its 200-day average.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Its wealth-management business gives stable fees, and capital-markets activity should improve. The stock is cheaper after its pullback.
rows.risks: It is below its 200-day average, and if it doesn't recover after earnings season it is the first to go.
